brief: TOP PICK: mattpocock/skills — Pre-built AI agent library for engineering tasks. Ship fast, own the 'agent component store' category before Vercel does.
BREAKOUT WINDOW: 4-6 weeks. Matt Pocock's brand + dev tooling gold rush = compounding distribution.
2nd: stablyai/orca — ADE for parallel coding agents. Emerging pattern, low competition, high developer pain.
AVOID: sindresorhus/awesome is a curated list, not a product. Skip.
DATA: 12 repos, all opp 8/breakout. Agent tooling is saturated — differentiate on UX, not features.

items.name: Graphify-Labs/graphify
items.one_liner: AST-based code knowledge graphs for deterministic codebase querying
items.pain_point: Developers waste hours tracing dependencies across large codebases; existing vector/RAG search is imprecise and hallucination-prone; solo devs and teams need accurate code understanding for onboarding, refactoring, and PR reviews
app_ideas: VS Code extension: real-time codebase Q&A with graph traversal instead of fuzzy search
GitHub PR reviewer: auto-generate architecture-aware PR descriptions by analyzing changed code's graph relationships
Legacy code migrator: identify refactoring targets by mapping dependency cycles and dead code paths
items.monetization: Freemium for individual devs (5 repos free), B2B API wrapper at $20-50/seat/month for teams, with enterprise tier for CI/CD integration
items.why_now: AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) are mainstream but still rely on imprecise vector search; deterministic graph approaches fill the accuracy gap exactly when devs demand reliable code intelligence
